name: Multivariate Observable-Event Discovery
authority: docs/OWNER_SPEC.md OWNER v2.0 and 2026-11-15 OWNER post-SPDE1

population.dedupPolicy: one per symbol/end timestamp, no frequency cap or retrospective event type elimination

targets.entry: at next fully completed M5 bar CLOSE end t+5m, historical bid-like bar proxy, not a fill

models.trainingSamplePolicy: all detected event clocks; inverse per-instrument training event count capped weight max4 only for instrument balance, no return-dependent selection

predictiveDecision.selection: first13w after training: frozen 2 horizons, all event tags, all 12 instruments. Record weekly paired MSE improvement vs zero, prior momentum and simple own-price, directional Brier vs train-only base rate, high/low excursion MAE and volatility-transition Brier. Do not elect a model from failed selection.
predictiveDecision.multiplicity: two horizons x three nontrivial variants; Bonferroni 6 for prospective one-sided weekly paired test on MSE-vs-simple and MSE-vs-momentum (12 familywise); no hindsight selection by symbol/event.
predictiveDecision.confidence: train-only posterior ridge mean standard error from XTX ridge inverse; normal 95% two-sided interval; compare predicted net to adverse current-term cost

economic.originalSourceCosts: BDP1/AIP1 original native C# verified paired BID/ASK and terms in first26 training weeks only
economic.policy: For selection/test report prospective conditional opportunities with positive adverse expected NET EUR lower95 and known valid minimum volume and swap. Choose maximum conservative EUR per exact event clock; skip overlap/unresolved same-symbol; no forced frequency. No event picked on future label availability.
economic.matchedComparator: cash and fixed prior momentum on identical selected clocks
economic.returnEur: original minimum notional EUR times bid-like M5 signed logreturn minus train original observed current-term adverse scenario cost bps, not actual fills

acceptance.criterion: robust positive weekly adjusted paired prediction vs both simple baselines in selection and exposed descriptive, calibration high/low not worse, then only if adverse economic EUR positive after valid portfolio; no promotion from exposed study
